criteria.reason: Handlers import only lib/services + lib/auth + lib/errors; no model import.

THE N+1 fix: list/feed eager-load tagList+author (1 query) then enrich via page-wide batched queries (favorites ids, grouped counts, following ids) mapped in memory via helpers.articleToJSON which does ZERO DB access. A unit test asserts <=6 queries for a 5-article page.
Responses match Conduit {articles,articlesCount}/{article}/{tags} shapes; 200/201/401/403/404/422 codes preserved.
No sequelize.sync in changed src (the sync export is a re-export for query-count testing only, never called at runtime).

note: All 6 criteria applicable, all 1.0. ARCH-02 is the headline constraint for this story and is verified by a query-count test.
